beats.text: Five underrated classics that deserve far more love than they get.
One. The Picture of Dorian Gray — Wilde's gorgeous, poisonous study of vanity.
Two. Heart of Darkness — Conrad's short, haunting voyage into human darkness.
Three. The Scarlet Letter — Hawthorne on shame, judgement, and quiet defiance.
Four. A Doll's House — Ibsen's play that slammed a door heard around the world.
Five. Siddhartha — Hesse's slim, luminous search for meaning by a river.
Not every great book is famous. Full retellings of these are on the channel.
